planner_json.title: Grade every keyed cell's rows from its own captured bytes through a per-harness table, on the live path
provides: gradeInvocation({record, entry, track, installation}) with the optional mapping field
table qualification over a capture set
consumes: GAW-1 runCell seam and adapter entry shape
boundary_contracts: capture record to check row: a verdict comes from that record's bytes through a table, or the row reads could-not-run with a stream-mapping reason
depends_on: GAW-1 (the runCell seam and adapter entry shape gradeInvocation plugs into)

write_prohibited: tests/sprint-01/** - locked; only GAW-1's and GAW-11's declared edits change them
test/harness/adapters/claude-code.mjs - adapters do not grade, and gradeCheck stays for the locked tests
test/harness/adapters/registry.mjs - GAW tasks own the registry
test/harness/schemas/** - the added fields need no schema edit
test/harness/fixtures/streams/** - E4 owns the archived captures

dispatched_run.description: One finished hand dispatch of harness-eval on hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect with its real artifacts
records: run_id re-fetched on every cold boot, never hard-coded

archived_captures.description: Real stdout bytes from a hosted run at the exact pinned CLI version, committed with hashes and source run id
records: its capture record, whose stdout sha256 equals those bytes

committed_real_capture.description: The real claude-code run committed by T15: CLI 2.1.314, process exit 0, one model request, a Bash denial and a Write denial, and no question

specification.objective: A dispatched keyed cell computes command_list, status and question_before_expensive_work rows from table-driven CanonicalEvents, each row citing evidence, and an absent or unqualified table reads could-not-run with a reason beginning `stream-mapping-`.
specification.success_state: On a finished run at HEAD, 10 keyed cells carry 40 rows that cite evidence, each question row carries question_count with answers_delivered 0, generic status text reads fail status-facts-absent, and both cursor cells read could-not-run missing-api-key.

requirements.title: Ten keyed cells carry four evidence-citing rows computed from their own streams
requirements.description: GIVEN `dispatched_run`, a finished hand dispatch of harness-eval on the landed commit, and `archived_captures`, real bytes at each pinned CLI version WHEN the maintainer downloads the result artifact of the newest completed run at HEAD and reads every keyed cell's check rows THEN 10 keyed cells carry 40 rows citing evidence, each question row carries question_count with answers_delivered 0, and generic status text reads fail status-facts-absent
requirements.positive_example: A run on the landed commit where 40 check rows on the ten keyed cells cite evidence, no pinned row reads a `stream-mapping-` reason, each question row carries question_count and answers_delivered 0, and both cursor cells read could-not-run missing-api-key.
requirements.red: Run 41249460968's artifact at 36e864a: 0 of 40 keyed rows cite evidence, 32 rows read `<harness>-adapter-not-implemented`, and claude-code's status row reads pass beside its question row reading `required-fact-unobserved`.
requirements.verification_service: real harness-eval run on a hosted runner with real CLIs and keys, read through gh artifacts

scenario.verification_service: real harness-eval run on a hosted runner with real CLIs and keys, read through gh artifacts

would_fail_if: the live cell still grades with the adapter's own line mapper and the table-driven stream layer stays disconnected
a check row is written with an empty evidence_paths list
a complete capture with no question reads could-not-run instead of fail

examples: jq prints `40` over the result artifact

build_proof.range: anything that proves a keyed cell's four rows are computed from its own captured bytes through a per-harness table, with the reply, the question and the completion read from events
examples: a harness-neutral normaliser driven by table rules
a live grade function every adapter calls after its invocation ends

steps: resolve the newest completed harness-eval run whose head_sha equals `git rev-parse HEAD`
download harness-eval-result-<run_id>-<attempt>
read every keyed cell's check rows

must_observe: `10` keyed cells each carry `4` rows, `40` rows in total, each with source `files-and-event-stream` and a non-empty `evidence_paths`
no row reads `required-fact-unobserved` where its capture record has prefix_complete `true`
each `question_before_expensive_work` row carries integer `question_count` and `answers_delivered` equal to `0`
both `cursor` cells read `could-not-run` `missing-api-key`
must_not_observe: `0` rows carrying evidence_paths, the reading of run 41249460968
a row with an empty reason and a verdict other than `pass`

steps: grade the archived real claude-code status-a reply against status-b's expected_facts, which differ only in gates.atoms

must_observe: verdict `fail`, reason `status-facts-absent`, `missing` contains `gates.atoms`

requirements.title: One grade function reads a real capture through a table, and a missing table is could-not-run
requirements.description: GIVEN `committed_real_capture`, the real claude-code run at CLI 2.1.314 with exit 0, Bash and Write denials, and no question WHEN gradeInvocation grades those bytes through a temp table at 2.1.314, through renamed rule ids, with no table, and in planted scratch copies THEN must-ask reads fail no-question-asked, renamed rules keep every event, no table reads could-not-run stream-mapping-absent, and a Write before a planted question reads fail expensive-before-question
requirements.positive_example: The committed capture graded must-ask with a temp copy of the table at 2.1.314 as its mapping reads `fail no-question-asked`, citing its stdout sha256. On the pinned track with no mapping, the same bytes read `could-not-run stream-mapping-absent`. A planted question placed before the first tool start reads pass, and one placed after the real `Write` reads fail expensive-before-question.
requirements.red: On base test/harness/graders/grade-invocation.mjs does not exist, normalise.mjs branches on rule_id `session-init` and `required-read-denial`, and no path fails a must-ask probe for expensive work first, so the import fails, a table with renamed rules loses its session and denial events, and the planted copy would pass.
requirements.verification_service: the real normaliser and gradeInvocation over a committed real claude-code capture

scenario.verification_service: the real normaliser and gradeInvocation over a committed real claude-code capture

would_fail_if: normalise.mjs keeps a branch on a claude rule_id, so a renamed table loses events
a stubbed verdict is returned with no capture read
a complete capture with no question reads could-not-run
an empty table still yields a verdict

build_proof.range: anything that proves one grade function computes a row from any harness's captured bytes through that harness's table, and that a missing table is could-not-run by name
examples: a rule-driven normaliser with path predicates and extract paths

steps: grade the capture with ask_policy must-ask, passing a temp copy of the claude table declaring 2.1.314 as its mapping with state `qualified`

must_observe: verdict `fail`, reason `no-question-asked`, citing the capture's stdout sha256

steps: normalise the capture through that temp table
rename every rule_id in the temp table and normalise again

must_observe: both runs yield the same event count, the same session id and the same reply beginning `I couldn't write to the file`
must_not_observe: `0` permission_denied events on the renamed run

steps: grade the capture on the pinned track with the real tables directory, which holds no table for 2.1.314

must_observe: verdict `could-not-run`, reason `stream-mapping-absent`, naming `2.1.314`
must_not_observe: no row at all for that check

steps: grade the capture with required_read_paths taken from the run's cwd and loaded plugin root
in a scratch copy, rewrite the denied Bash call's command to run `node <plugin root>/scripts/gate.mjs audit`, labelled planted, and grade again

must_observe: the `Write` denial on `work/keep.txt` reads required_read `true` and verdict `fail` reason `denied_tool_call` beside process_exit_code `0`
the real Bash denial of `ls` reads required_read `false`
the planted denial of a plugin script reads required_read `true`

steps: in a scratch copy, append a planted USER_CHOICE-shaped agent text after the real `Write` tool start, and grade must-ask with that same mapping
in another, place that text before the first tool start, and grade must-ask
in a third, rewrite the first Bash call to run `node <plugin root>/scripts/gate.mjs audit`, place the text after it, and grade must-ask

must_observe: first copy: verdict `fail`, reason `expensive-before-question`, naming `Write`
second copy: verdict `pass`, question_count `1`, answers_delivered `0`
third copy: the plugin script counts as local-read, so the reason is not `expensive-before-question`
must_not_observe: no reason on the first copy

Every keyed check row cites a non-empty evidence_paths list when the run at HEAD finishes
Both cursor cells read `could-not-run` `missing-api-key` when the run at HEAD finishes

integration_obligations.completion_rule: FLOW-GRD-02-FOUR-GRADES passes on the trunk when `node --test --test-name-pattern 'FLOW-GRD-02-FOUR-GRADES' tests/sprint-02/grd-02-four-grades.test.mjs` exits 0 against a completed harness-eval run whose head_sha equals the trunk candidate, and its artifact .tmp/sprint-02-verification/grd-02-four-grades.json is retained with its expected observations matched.

split_check.kept_because: I tried cutting the neutral normaliser from the live wiring. That is the exact seam sprint 01 shipped: T6 and T7 landed green modules with test callers only, and the hosted cell never reached them. The behavior is one row computed from one capture, and it cannot be watched until both halves are joined.
